hints.trailingComma: There seems to be an extra comma before closing the object or list. Remove the last comma.
hints.singleQuotes: JSON only accepts double quotes ("). Replace the single quotes (') with double ones.
hints.unquotedKey: Keys must be wrapped in double quotes: {"key": 1}.
hints.comments: JSON doesn't allow comments (// or /* */). Delete them.
hints.missingComma: A comma is missing between two items.
hints.missingColon: The ":" between a key and its value is missing.
hints.unexpectedEnd: The text ends too early: a closing brace }, bracket ] or quote is missing.
hints.unterminatedString: A text value is missing its closing quote.
hints.controlChar: There is a line break or a tab inside a text value. Write it as \n or \t.
hints.badEscape: A backslash (\) is followed by a character that isn't allowed. Write the backslash as \\.
hints.nonJsonValue: NaN, Infinity and undefined don't exist in JSON. Use null or a number.
hints.extraContent: There is extra text after the JSON. Remove it or put everything inside an array.
hints.emptyDocument: Paste here the JSON document you want to check.
hints.emptySchema: Paste here the JSON Schema to validate against.
hints.unsupportedDraft: This JSON Schema version isn't supported ({schema}). Use draft-04, draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12.
hints.unresolvedRef: The schema uses a reference (“{ref}”) that can't be found. Only internal references (#/…) are resolved: this tool makes no network requests.
hints.badPattern: A regular expression in the schema isn't valid: {reason}
hints.circularRef: The schema has a circular reference that never ends.
hints.timeout: The validation took too long and was cancelled. This is usually caused by a very costly regular expression (pattern) in the schema.
hints.schema_type: “type” must be one of: array, boolean, integer, null, number, object or string (or a list of them).
hints.kw_type: A value of type “{expected}” was expected, but it is of type “{actual}”.
hints.kw_enum: The value isn't one of the allowed ones: {list}.
hints.kw_format: The text doesn't have the “{format}” format.
hints.kw_pattern: The text doesn't match the pattern {pattern}.
hints.kw_patternNoValue: The text doesn't match the pattern given in the schema.
hints.kw_minimum: The value {value} is below the minimum allowed ({limit}).
hints.kw_maximum: The value {value} is above the maximum allowed ({limit}).
hints.kw_exclusiveMinimum: The value {value} must be greater than {limit}.
hints.kw_exclusiveMaximum: The value {value} must be less than {limit}.
hints.kw_multipleOf: The value {value} must be a multiple of {limit}.
hints.kw_minLength: The text is too short: it has {length} characters and the minimum is {limit}.
hints.kw_maxLength: The text is too long: it has {length} characters and the maximum is {limit}.
hints.kw_minItems: The list has too few items: {length} and the minimum is {limit}.
hints.kw_maxItems: The list has too many items: {length} and the maximum is {limit}.
hints.kw_uniqueItems: The list has repeated items (positions {a} and {b}).
hints.kw_minProperties: The object must have at least {limit} properties.
hints.kw_maxProperties: The object must have at most {limit} properties.
hints.kw_propertyNames: The property name “{property}” doesn't follow the schema's rules.
hints.kw_contains: The list must contain at least one item that matches the given schema.
hints.kw_anyOf: The value doesn't match any of the allowed options (anyOf).
hints.kw_oneOf: The value must match exactly one of the options (oneOf) and it matches {matches}.
hints.kw_not: The value matches something the schema forbids (not).

desc.trailingComma: Extra comma before closing: remove the last comma

desc.nonJsonValue: NaN, Infinity and undefined don't exist: use null or a number

desc.string: A bare text value in double quotes
desc.bom: An invisible mark at the start of the file: it is ignored

ui.cardAria: Tool to validate XML

hints.mismatchedTag: A tag is closed with a different name than the one that was opened. Check that every <tag> is closed with </tag>, in the right order.
hints.unclosedTag: A tag is not closed: every <tag> needs its </tag> (or must be written as <tag/>).
hints.extraContent: There can be only one root element, and there is more content after it. Wrap everything in a single element.
hints.noRoot: The text doesn't start with a tag. XML must start with an element, such as <root>.
hints.unescapedAmpersand: There is a stray &. In XML it is written as &.
hints.unescapedLt: There is a < where it shouldn't be. If it is part of a text, write it as <.
hints.undefinedEntity: This entity doesn't exist in XML (like  ). Write the character directly or use its code, for example  .
hints.attributeQuotes: Attribute values must always be quoted: name="value".
hints.duplicateAttribute: An attribute is repeated within the same tag.
hints.declPosition: The <?xml …?> declaration must come first, with no spaces or lines before it.

hints.tabIndent: YAML doesn't allow tabs for indentation. Replace them with spaces.
hints.badIndent: The indentation is inconsistent: items at the same level must start in the same column and children need more spaces than their parent. It also happens when a line has two “:” (put the text in quotes).
hints.duplicateKey: A key is repeated at the same level. Each key can appear only once.
hints.unclosedQuote: A quote is missing its closing mark.
hints.unclosedFlow: A closing bracket ] or brace } is missing.
hints.unknownAlias: An alias (*name) is used without an anchor (&name) defined before it.
hints.unknownTag: This tag (!!type) isn't recognized. Remove it or use a standard YAML type.
hints.unexpectedContent: There is content that doesn't fit with what came before: for example, mixing a list (- item) with keys (key: value) at the same level, or leftover text.

ui.cardAria: Tool to validate TOML

hints.unclosedString: A quote is missing its closing mark.
hints.unclosedArray: An array is missing its closing ].
hints.invalidValue: This value isn't valid in TOML. Text goes in double quotes ("text"); numbers, true/false and dates go without quotes.
hints.duplicateKey: This key or table is already defined; it can't be repeated.
hints.illegalKey: A key can only contain letters, numbers, dashes and underscores (or be quoted). Is the = between the key and the value missing?
hints.incompleteKey: Something is missing: a key without its = and value, or a [name] table not closed with ].
hints.invalidDate: The date isn't valid. Use the YYYY-MM-DD format with a real month and day.
hints.oneEntryPerLine: Each key = value goes on its own line.
hints.leadingZero: A number can't start with 0 (except 0, 0.x or the 0x, 0o and 0b formats).
hints.badUnderscore: Underscores can only go between two digits, as in 1_000.
hints.badEscape: After a backslash only n, t, r, b, f, ", \, u or U are allowed. For a Windows path use single quotes: 'C:\path'.
